title: Section & Claims Hierarchy Validations
walkthroughSteps: Apply AC-01 — SEC-001 has open deductible + salvage blockers
Click ⋮ → Close Section on Section 001 → modal shows 2 blockers
Apply AC-02 — SEC-002 has litigation + reserves + payments blockers
Click ⋮ → Close Section on Section 002 → modal shows 3 blockers
Apply AC-03 — SEC-003 has provider blocker only
Click ⋮ → Close Section on Section 003 → modal shows 1 blocker
Apply AC-04 — all sections clear, close SEC-001 → checklist → reason → closed
Apply AC-05 — all sections clear → close all 3 → go to overview → Close Claim available

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Section closure blocked when deductible + salvage open
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: When Section 001 has an open deductible task and pending salvage activity, clicking Close Section opens a modal showing both blockers. The modal has no Continue button — only Cancel.

setup.description: SEC-001 mock data has hasOpenDeductible=true and hasActiveSalvage=true. No state overrides needed — blockers come from section flags.

preconditions.text: Close Section modal shows 'Open Manage Deductible task must be closed'
Close Section modal shows 'Pending salvage activity must be resolved'

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Section closure blocked when litigation + reserves + payments open
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Section 002 has active litigation, open reserves, and pending payments — modal shows all 3 blockers.

setup.description: SEC-002 mock data has hasActiveLitigation=true, hasOpenReserves=true, hasOpenPayments=true.

visualCues: Blocker: 'Active litigation assignment must be resolved'

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Section closure blocked when active provider assignment
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Section 003 has an active provider assignment — modal shows 1 blocker.

visualCues: Blocker: 'Active provider assignment must be finalised'

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Section closes successfully when no blockers — checklist + reason required
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: When a section has no blockers, the modal opens at the pre-closure checklist (step 2). Handler must tick all 5 items then select a closure reason before Close Section executes.

setup.description: All section blocker flags set to false so modal skips step 1.

preconditions.text: Continue disabled until all 5 checkboxes ticked
After reason selected: Close Section button enabled
Section row shows Closed chip after modal closes

expectedUI.description: Modal opens at step 2 — checklist, then step 3 — reason
visualCues: 5 checkboxes, Continue disabled until all checked
Close Section button spins then section row updates to Closed

howToTest.action: Click ⋮ → Close Section on any section

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Claim closure only available when all sections are Closed
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: With all 3 sections Closed, navigating to Claim Overview shows the Close Claim button enabled. If any section is still Open, sections blocker appears in claim closure modal.

setup.description: All sections closed + all tasks done so only section blocker gate is tested.

preconditions.text: Claim closure modal proceeds past step 1

expectedUI.description: Claim closure modal step 1 has no section blocker
visualCues: Close Claim button active on overview page
Modal step 1 does not show sections blocker
